_comment: QUESTIONS THE STEEL CENSUS RAISED AND DID NOT ANSWER. Brief 8: where an entry raises a
question the perimeter rules do not settle, the entry is classed `held for ruling`, the
question is written here with the source sentence and what the rule would need to say, and
the pass continues. A QUESTION OF THIS KIND NEVER CHANGES A RULE BY ITSELF.
Two of the three below are not `held for ruling` entries at all: they are tensions between
two entries this census classed in opposite directions on the same leg. They are recorded
because a reader who finds the two classes side by side is entitled to see that the pass

questions.question: Is hydrogen fired in a works' BURNERS a 'hydrogen-ready furnace' for the steel perimeter, at a works whose steelmaking furnace is an existing scrap EAF?
questions.why_the_rules_did_not_settle_it: The perimeter's four legs are an announced DRI plant, an EAF replacing blast-furnace capacity, greenfield DRI/EAF primary steelmaking, and a hydrogen-ready furnace. ArcelorMittal Sestao has no blast furnace, is not greenfield, and the DRI it will be fed by is at GIJÓN — a different works, admitted separately. What is at Sestao is EUR 50 million and hydrogen fed to burners.
questions.source_sentence: In addition to the investments in the DRI and EAF installations in Gijón, ArcelorMittal will invest €50 million in Sestao. This, together with the green DRI and hydrogen feeding the burners, will result in the Sestao plant achieving zero carbon-emissions.
questions.speaker: ArcelorMittal, own announcement with the Government of Spain
questions.rule_would_need_to_say: Whether 'hydrogen-ready furnace' names the vessel that makes the steel, or any fired equipment at the works. If the former, Sestao is refused and its zero-carbon claim rests on iron made elsewhere. If the latter, reheat and annealing furnaces across the sector come into scope, and the sector's population changes shape.
questions.note: THE ONE PLANT IN NINETY-FIVE WHERE GEM'S SILENCE HID SOMETHING. GEM records nothing forward at Sestao; the owner announces an investment there in the same breath as the Gijón DRI.

entries: P100000120759 Van Merksteijn International — perimeter exclusion
questions.question: When is a greenfield scrap EAF 'greenfield DRI/EAF primary steelmaking', and when is it 'scrap EAF, no primary capacity'?
questions.why_the_rules_did_not_settle_it: The perimeter admits 'greenfield DRI/EAF primary steelmaking' in its third leg and refuses 'a standalone scrap-EAF mill at a site with no primary steelmaking' in its first clause. A NEW EAF ON A GREENFIELD SITE MELTING SCRAP SATISFIES BOTH SENTENCES. This census admitted Ussuri Capital's Romanian works, whose owner states 'EAF and continuous strip casting module will be built to produce ~1.2 MT/year of crude steel and hot rolled coils using local scrap', and refused Van Merksteijn's Eemshaven mill, whose owner states it will produce 'wire rod from the secondary raw material cleaned scrap steel'. Both are greenfield, both melt scrap, and the pass separated them on whether the owner calls the output crude steel — which is a distinction the rule does not draw.
questions.rule_would_need_to_say: Whether 'primary steelmaking' in the third leg means making crude steel from any feed, or making iron from ore. If the latter, a greenfield scrap EAF is always refused and Ussuri is reclassed. If the former, the refusal clause needs a narrower wording than 'no primary capacity', because a greenfield EAF has no capacity of any kind until it is built.
questions.note: THE PASS COULD HAVE HIDDEN THIS by classing both the same way and saying nothing. The two classes stand as the reading that seemed right at the time, and the question says why that reading is not secure.

entries: P100000120482 Tata Steel Port Talbot — named not admitted
questions.question: Not a rule question. A search question, recorded so it is not mistaken for a finding about the works.
questions.why_it_is_here: GEM records an EAF in construction at Port Talbot. Sixteen citations from the works' own gem.wiki page were followed and not one is a Tata Steel document about the project. It is the largest single steel investment in the United Kingdom, it is almost certainly in perimeter, and this register cannot yet source it. THE CLASS IS A STATEMENT ABOUT THE SEARCH, NOT ABOUT THE PROJECT, and it will move the moment a Tata Steel page is read.
questions.rule_would_need_to_say: Nothing. What is needed is a fetch, and the next pass should start at tatasteeluk.com rather than at the wiki's citation list.
